checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Reel starts with the café storefront, keeping striped awning and outdoor tables
must.why: Clip 1 shows the navy and cream striped awning, wooden door and bistro chairs and tables. It is cropped to vertical with a slow push-in.

must.item: Latte and pastry counter both recognisable in later shots
must.why: The latte is clearly recognisable, with the leaf-foam art, marble table and cup. No pastry frames were provided, so the croissant shot can't be checked.

must.item: Opening text exactly 'Maple Street Café' and closing text exactly 'Your morning starts here'
must.why: The opening text builds up to a clean 'Maple Street Café' with the accent. The closing clip was not provided, so that line can't be verified.

must.item: Gentle visible movement, framed without stretching
must.why: The storefront has a slow push-in and the latte has a slow drift and zoom. Proportions look natural, with no stretching.

must.item: Vertical, about 9 s, soft upbeat music with no speech
must.why: The frames are vertical 480x858 and the clips are 3 s each. The full 9 s reel and the music weren't provided. The audio file is 15 s, not 9 s, and the music can't be judged.

exact_text.read_as: Not visible in the provided frames (the pastry clip was not provided)

faults.what: The pastry clip and closing-text frames were not provided, so the third shot and its text can't be confirmed.
The storefront is cropped tighter than the photo, so the left table and some of the awning edges are cut off while it pushes in. The text is a bit small.
The latte's cup and leaf look slightly altered and regenerated, though the match is close. The latte clip has an odd iridescent sheen on the cup handle.
The audio file is 15 s, longer than the 9 s reel. The reel uses straight cuts.

summary: The storefront and latte clips look good, with correct opening text and gentle motion, but the pastry clip and closing text were not provided, so the full reel can't be confirmed.
